feeds.title: Pinball News
feeds.description: Pinball News is the world's premier website for news from the pinball world. All the new games get a unique in-depth review to tell you everything you need to know about them. They travel to pinball shows around the world to report for you, plus they have the most comprehensive diary of pinball events, they explain all those confusing abbreviations and much, much more.

feeds.title: Pinball Magazine
feeds.description: Pinball Magazine is a non-periodical, in-depth, printed, glossy, magazine publication for pinball players, collectors, operators, and other pinball enthusiasts. It largely focuses on people who play, or played, an important role in the development of pinball, their work, the promotion of pinball, and/or other forms of support for pinball.

feeds.description: Weekly updates on what is happening in the pinball world, including new games/rumors, production and coding updates, pinball show reviews and announcements, results from competitions, notable pinball streams, videos, podcasts, and much more. Get to know pinball-related information and the latest news.
